must_catch.item: The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal.
No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence.

data.notes: The report gets the core story right. The portal was the way in, but the deal turned on the CFO's nine-day close and a value case built from her own statements ('that's my number, not yours'). It keeps the dollar figure and Fiserv's pitch as unknowns and lists both as follow-ups. Its weaknesses are small but real. The gaps section labels 'She let it go' as fact when it is the rep's opinion. The competitor insight overstates with 'Fiserv never really competed' and never says outright that the request for a named contact shows the bank relationship was weaker than it looked. The messaging changes leave out the counter-reader demo, which appears only in the gaps section.
